title: Find the Maximum
description:
# Find the Maximum

This program reads a list of integers (on one line, space-separated) and should print the **largest** value.

But it has a bug. Find and fix it so the tests pass.

## Input

One line of space-separated integers (at least one).

## Output

The largest integer.

```
Input:
3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6

Output:
9
```
